Daisy Bell (Kelly/Lochbaum/Mathews) appears on the out-of-print Decca compilation 'Music from Mathematics'; the 'Voice of the Computer' (DL 710180) issue also long out of print. No official digital compilation found; free reference streams exist (Library of Congress, Internet Archive).
